description: MariaDB 11.4 server configuration rendered to /etc/mysql/mariadb.conf.d/50-server.cnf ([mariadb] section).

fields.description: InnoDB buffer pool. Upstream default 128M.
fields.name: innodb_buffer_pool_size
fields.title: Buffer pool size

fields.description: Size of the redo log. Unlike MySQL 8.0.30+, MariaDB keeps this variable — there is no innodb_redo_log_capacity.
fields.name: innodb_log_file_size
fields.title: Redo log size

fields.description: In-memory redo buffer.
fields.name: innodb_log_buffer_size
fields.title: Log buffer size

fields.description: 1 = ACID, 2 = write on commit and fsync once a second, 0 = neither.
fields.name: innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit
fields.title: Flush log at commit

fields.description: Background flush budget in IOPS.
fields.name: innodb_io_capacity
fields.title: I/O capacity

fields.description: Catch-up flush budget; upstream default is max(2000, 2 x innodb_io_capacity).
fields.name: innodb_io_capacity_max
fields.title: I/O capacity max

fields.description: Background read threads.
fields.name: innodb_read_io_threads
fields.title: Read I/O threads

fields.description: Background write threads.
fields.name: innodb_write_io_threads
fields.title: Write I/O threads

fields.description: Row-lock wait before the statement is rolled back.
fields.name: innodb_lock_wait_timeout
fields.title: Lock wait timeout

fields.description: Store each table in its own .ibd tablespace. Deprecated since 11.0.1 — the shared tablespace is on its way out.
fields.name: innodb_file_per_table
fields.title: File per table

fields.description: 0 = table lock, 1 = consecutive (the default), 2 = interleaved — the only mode Galera supports.
fields.name: innodb_autoinc_lock_mode
fields.title: Auto-increment lock mode

fields.description: Base name of the binary logs; binary logging is off by default in MariaDB, setting this enables it.
fields.name: log_bin
fields.title: Binary log base name

fields.description: MariaDB's upstream default is MIXED; Galera requires ROW.
fields.name: binlog_format
fields.title: Binlog format

fields.description: How much of each row is logged.
fields.name: binlog_row_image
fields.title: Binlog row image

fields.description: fsync the binary log every N commit groups; MariaDB's default is 0 (leave it to the OS).
fields.name: sync_binlog
fields.title: Sync binlog

fields.description: Purge age of the binary logs; 0 disables purging. Takes precedence over expire_logs_days.
fields.name: binlog_expire_logs_seconds
fields.title: Binlog retention

fields.description: Write replicated events into this server's own binary log.
fields.name: log_slave_updates
fields.title: Log slave updates

fields.description: Refuse out-of-order GTIDs; MariaDB has no gtid_mode — GTIDs always exist.
fields.name: gtid_strict_mode
fields.title: GTID strict mode

fields.description: Replication domain this server writes to; a multi-source or multi-writer setup needs distinct domains.
fields.name: gtid_domain_id
fields.title: GTID domain id

fields.description: Skip events whose GTID was already applied in that domain.
fields.name: gtid_ignore_duplicates
fields.title: Ignore duplicate GTIDs

fields.description: Semisynchronous primary side. MariaDB keeps the master/slave names and needs no plugin_load.
fields.name: rpl_semi_sync_master_enabled
fields.title: Semisync master

fields.description: Wait for a replica ack before falling back to asynchronous.
fields.name: rpl_semi_sync_master_timeout
fields.title: Semisync timeout

fields.description: AFTER_SYNC acks before the storage commit, AFTER_COMMIT after it.
fields.name: rpl_semi_sync_master_wait_point
fields.title: Semisync wait point

fields.description: Semisynchronous replica side.
fields.name: rpl_semi_sync_slave_enabled
fields.title: Semisync slave

fields.description: Applier worker threads; 0 = single-threaded. MariaDB has no replica_parallel_workers.
fields.name: slave_parallel_threads
fields.title: Parallel applier threads

fields.description: How aggressively the applier parallelizes.
fields.name: slave_parallel_mode
fields.title: Parallel applier mode

fields.description: Reject writes from clients without SUPER — set on replicas.
fields.name: read_only
fields.title: Read only

fields.description: Enable write-set replication; the whole wsrep_* block below is only rendered when this is ON.
fields.name: wsrep_on
fields.title: Galera enabled

fields.description: Path to the Galera library.
fields.name: wsrep_provider
fields.title: Galera provider

fields.description: Logical cluster name; must be identical on every node.
fields.name: wsrep_cluster_name
fields.title: Cluster name

fields.description: How a joiner gets a full state snapshot. mariabackup is non-blocking; rsync blocks the donor.
fields.name: wsrep_sst_method
fields.title: SST method

fields.description: user:password for backup SST; filled by the server from topology, unused by rsync.
fields.name: wsrep_sst_auth
fields.title: SST credentials

fields.description: Threads applying write-sets from other nodes.
fields.name: wsrep_slave_threads
fields.title: Galera applier threads

fields.description: Bitmask of statement classes that wait for the node to catch up first; 0 = never wait, 1 = SELECT.
fields.name: wsrep_sync_wait
fields.title: Sync wait bitmask

fields.description: Address mariadbd listens on.
fields.name: bind_address
fields.title: Bind address

fields.description: TCP port.
fields.name: port
fields.title: Port

fields.description: Maximum simultaneous client connections.
fields.name: max_connections
fields.title: Max connections

fields.description: Failed handshakes from one host before it is blocked.
fields.name: max_connect_errors
fields.title: Max connect errors

fields.description: Threads kept for reuse.
fields.name: thread_cache_size
fields.title: Thread cache size

fields.description: Idle seconds before a non-interactive connection is closed.
fields.name: wait_timeout
fields.title: Wait timeout

fields.description: Idle seconds before an interactive connection is closed.
fields.name: interactive_timeout
fields.title: Interactive timeout

fields.description: Largest single packet.
fields.name: max_allowed_packet
fields.title: Max allowed packet

fields.description: Open table handles cached across sessions.
fields.name: table_open_cache
fields.title: Table open cache

fields.description: Cached table definitions.
fields.name: table_definition_cache
fields.title: Table definition cache

fields.description: Largest in-memory internal temporary table.
fields.name: tmp_table_size
fields.title: Temp table size

fields.description: Largest MEMORY table; also caps tmp_table_size.
fields.name: max_heap_table_size
fields.title: Max heap table size

fields.description: File descriptors requested from the OS.
fields.name: open_files_limit
fields.title: Open files limit

fields.description: MariaDB's default (unchanged since 10.2.4 and identical in 10.11 and 11.4) still contains NO_AUTO_CREATE_USER, which MySQL 8 removed.
fields.name: sql_mode
fields.title: SQL mode

fields.description: MariaDB's upstream default is latin1 until 11.6; stroppy pins utf8mb4 so results are comparable with MySQL runs.
fields.name: character_set_server
fields.title: Server character set

fields.description: Must belong to character_set_server. MariaDB's own default is latin1_swedish_ci up to 11.7 and utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci from 11.8; stroppy keeps utf8mb4_general_ci on every line so MariaDB runs stay comparable with each other and with MySQL.
fields.name: collation_server
fields.title: Server collation

fields.description: Server time zone; a fixed offset keeps benchmark timestamps reproducible.
fields.name: default_time_zone
fields.title: Default time zone

fields.description: 0 = as stored, 1 = lowercased, 2 = stored as given and compared lowercase. Fixed at datadir initialization.
fields.name: lower_case_table_names
fields.title: Lower case table names

fields.description: Instrumentation engine; off by default in MariaDB.
fields.name: performance_schema
fields.title: Performance schema

fields.description: Log every statement — far too expensive during a load test.
fields.name: general_log
fields.title: General log

fields.description: Log statements slower than log_slow_query_time. Renamed from slow_query_log in 10.11.
fields.name: log_slow_query
fields.title: Slow query log

fields.description: Slow-query threshold in seconds; fractions allowed.
fields.name: log_slow_query_time
fields.title: Slow query threshold

fields.description: Comma-separated extras in the slow log (query_plan, innodb, explain, engine, warnings, full, all); empty by default.
fields.name: log_slow_verbosity
fields.title: Slow log verbosity

fields.description: Error-log verbosity. MariaDB has no log_error_verbosity; this is its equivalent.
fields.name: log_warnings
fields.title: Warning verbosity

fields.description: Torn-page protection. 11.x adds `fast`, which skips the doublewrite fsync on already-durable storage.
fields.name: innodb_doublewrite
fields.title: Doublewrite buffer

fields.description: Let the OS page cache buffer redo writes. Part of the set that replaced innodb_flush_method in 11.0.
fields.name: innodb_log_file_buffering
fields.title: Buffer the redo log

fields.description: Let the OS page cache buffer data-file writes; OFF is the O_DIRECT equivalent.
fields.name: innodb_data_file_buffering
fields.title: Buffer the data files

fields.description: Default isolation level; the MySQL-compatible name, available since 11.1. tx_isolation still works but is deprecated.
fields.name: transaction_isolation
fields.title: Transaction isolation

fields.description: Unique replication id; filled by the server from topology.
fields.name: server_id
fields.title: Server id

fields.description: Address this replica reports to its primary; filled by the server from topology.
fields.name: report_host
fields.title: Report host

fields.description: gcomm:// URL listing the cluster members; filled by the server from topology.
fields.name: wsrep_cluster_address
fields.title: Galera cluster address

fields.description: This node's ip[:port] for group communication; filled by the server from topology.
fields.name: wsrep_node_address
fields.title: Galera node address

fields.description: This node's name inside the cluster; filled by the server from topology.
fields.name: wsrep_node_name
fields.title: Galera node name

fields.description: Raw `key = value` settings appended verbatim at the end of the file; keys must match ^[a-z_][a-z0-9_.]*$. Entry order is not preserved.
fields.name: custom
fields.title: Extra settings

computed.expr:
(("server_id" in root) ? "server_id" + " = " + string(root["server_id"]) + "\n" : "") +
(("report_host" in root) ? "report_host" + " = " + string(root["report_host"]) + "\n" : "")

fields.description: Rendered topology lines (server_id, report_host).
fields.name: cluster_lines
fields.title: Cluster lines

computed.expr:
((("wsrep_on" in root) && root.wsrep_on == "ON") ? ("wsrep_on = ON
" +
(("wsrep_provider" in root) ? "wsrep_provider" + " = " + string(root["wsrep_provider"]) + "
" : "") +
(("wsrep_cluster_name" in root) ? "wsrep_cluster_name" + " = " + string(root["wsrep_cluster_name"]) + "
" : "") +
(("wsrep_cluster_address" in root) ? "wsrep_cluster_address" + " = " + string(root["wsrep_cluster_address"]) + "
" : "") +
(("wsrep_node_address" in root) ? "wsrep_node_address" + " = " + string(root["wsrep_node_address"]) + "
" : "") +
(("wsrep_node_name" in root) ? "wsrep_node_name" + " = " + string(root["wsrep_node_name"]) + "
" : "") +
(("wsrep_sst_method" in root) ? "wsrep_sst_method" + " = " + string(root["wsrep_sst_method"]) + "
" : "") +
(("wsrep_sst_auth" in root) ? "wsrep_sst_auth" + " = " + string(root["wsrep_sst_auth"]) + "
" : "") +
(("wsrep_slave_threads" in root) ? "wsrep_slave_threads" + " = " + string(root["wsrep_slave_threads"]) + "
" : "") +
(("wsrep_sync_wait" in root) ? "wsrep_sync_wait" + " = " + string(root["wsrep_sync_wait"]) + "
" : "")) : "wsrep_on = OFF
")

fields.description: The whole wsrep_* block, emitted only when wsrep_on is ON.
fields.name: galera_lines
fields.title: Galera lines

fields.description: The `custom` map joined into config lines; the template prints it at the end of the file.
fields.name: custom_rendered
fields.title: Rendered extra settings

rules.expr: !("innodb_io_capacity" in root) || !("innodb_io_capacity_max" in root) || int(root.innodb_io_capacity_max) >= int(root.innodb_io_capacity)
!("wsrep_on" in root) || root.wsrep_on != "ON" || (!("binlog_format" in root) || root.binlog_format == "ROW")
!("wsrep_on" in root) || root.wsrep_on != "ON" || (("innodb_autoinc_lock_mode" in root) && int(root.innodb_autoinc_lock_mode) == 2)
!("wsrep_on" in root) || root.wsrep_on != "ON" || (("wsrep_provider" in root) && string(root.wsrep_provider) != "")
!("max_heap_table_size" in root) || !("tmp_table_size" in root) || int(root.max_heap_table_size) >= int(root.tmp_table_size)
